However, the company exhibits a weak liquidity profile with a current ratio of 0.72 (current assets of 674M against current liabilities of 932M) and a moderately high leverage ratio (total liabilities to equity of approximately 1.93). These balanced factors—strong operating performance offset by near-term liquidity tightness—align with an investment-grade rating at the lower end of the spectrum.

DECISION: BBB
